summary: Focused mail-scroll regression validation completed for WorkSpaceX mail viewers. Added deterministic Playwright fixture test for long HTML with sender root overflow:hidden (including !important variant), plain text fallback, scroll reset, keyboard navigation, and iframe safety checks; plus shared-style unit guard. Desktop 1920x800 and 1280x800 pass for both MailMsgView and MailTempPane. Mobile 390x800 still fails in account-viewer wheel-to-last scenario.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390x800, real mouse wheel did not bring #last paragraph into iframe viewport in deterministic account-view fixture.

issues: Potential clipping/scroll routing conflict for opened message at narrow viewport; needs manual confirmation on real touch device.

action_items: Investigate mobile (390x800) wheel-scroll path in MailMsgView iframe and confirm whether event is routed to iframe or outer container.
After fix, re-run tests/e2e/63-mail-scroll-regression.spec.ts for all three viewports.
Optionally add a dedicated touch-scroll assertion for true mobile gesture behavior if product requires phone support.
critical_code_review_comments: screen-mail.css mobile section sets fixed message body height (520px) and page-level overflow-y:auto; this can create nested scroll behavior conflicts for narrow layouts.
Keep CSP/sandbox strict: current regression confirms sender inline script remains blocked; do not relax script restrictions while adjusting scroll behavior.
seed_data_creation: Deterministic fixtures used in 63-mail-scroll-regression.spec.ts (MOCKED network at browser-route level for mail APIs). Real-provider smoke executed via 61-mail-ctx-menu.spec.ts using rich-mail helper; temporary box cleanup handled by existing helper logic.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Do not rework desktop assertions; 1920x800 and 1280x800 are stable. Current unresolved point is only 390x800 wheel-to-last in account viewer path. Three attempts were made to stabilize wheel routing (scrollIntoView, iframe body focus click, increased wheel loops) but mobile case still failed. Avoid further selector churn; investigate runtime scroll target/overflow chain first.
rca of the issue: Repro: run APP_URL=<preview> npx playwright test tests/e2e/63-mail-scroll-regression.spec.ts --project=chromium. Result: desktop tests pass, mobile case fails at wheel-based last-paragraph reach in account viewer. Likely cause: nested scroll chain on mobile layout (.mail-page overflow-y:auto + constrained .mail-view-body) can intercept wheel before iframe document consumes it. Mitigation: confirm active scrolling element during wheel in mobile layout and ensure iframe region receives wheel input when hovered/focused.
